# Divisions
Divisions are numbered 1 to 7, and the number leads every callsign. Entry and transfer requirements are shown under each division.
A site works for one division. Its Division Manager claims that division when they arrive and draws its kit. A division answers for its own results. Divisions don't interfere in each other's affairs without the senior employee's approval.
## 1. Special Services (Spc Serv.) [italic]Open application.[/italic] Sales, transport, catering, employment and everything that doesn't belong to another desk. It also handles matters that need discretion. Special Services takes referrals no other division should be seen handling, and its records are kept separately. Employees don't ask Special Services about its work.
## 2. Corporate Relations (C.R.) [italic]Minimum one year with the Company.[/italic] Corporate Liaisons are drawn from this division. It builds and maintains the Company's friendships. Corporate Relations manages the colonial partnership, entertains visiting officials, and makes sure the Company's friends feel appreciated. Gifts it gives are recorded as Community Investment.
## 3. Communications (Comms.) [italic]Minimum one year with the Company.[/italic] Keeps every Company facility in contact with the rest. When a site stops answering, Communications finds out why. It also controls what the Company says, and what is said about it. Communications handles all public statements, intercepts and secure traffic. Unfortunate events are given the correct context before anyone outside the Company hears about them.
## 4. PMC Dispatch (PMC Disp.) [italic]Minimum three years with the Company and a reference from within the division.[/italic] Liaises with contracted security providers. PMC Dispatch requests, briefs and directs contractor teams when a situation is beyond site security. Contractors are expensive. Their deployment is justified in writing, afterwards.
## 5. Research and Development (R&D) [italic]Open application.[/italic] Company data and research, unusual chemicals, and specimens that have left containment. It supports the Lead Researcher. The division secures funding, materials and specimens for Company research. When a specimen can't be obtained through ordinary channels, the division finds another channel.
## 6. Economics (Eco.) [italic]Minimum two years with the Company and a reference from within the division.[/italic] Trade between factions, goods of every kind, and markets the Company doesn't advertise. It manages the site's books. Economics oversees audits, freight, trading and the colony's loan accounts. A colony in debt to the Company is a colony that listens.
## 7. Personal Protection (Per. Pro.) [italic]Open application.[/italic] Internal close protection. It is responsible for the safety of senior executives. Personal Protection directs the protection detail and decides where executives may safely go.
